title: Apple Trade-In Update: Samsung Foldables Added?
description: Apple adjusted iPhone and Apple Watch trade-in values and added Samsung foldables to its program. Source: 9to5Mac This is a short news summary.
narration: Apple now accepts Samsung foldables. This is part of a trade-in update. That is a change. According to 9to5Mac, Apple adjusted trade-in values for iPhones and Apple Watches. MacRumors also wrote about the change. MacRumors reports Samsung foldables were added to the trade-in program. The changes touch three areas. One is iPhone trade-in values. Another is Apple Watch trade-in values. The last is Samsung foldable phones. This expands what Apple accepts for trade-in. The reports come from 9to5Mac and MacRumors. Apple is behind the program change. The stories do not give exact numbers. It focuses on trade-in eligibility. The program is run by Apple. Subscribe for more daily tech news.
